snippet.title: Tideborne Haven - Extended Trailer
snippet.description:
LAST CHANCE TO SUPPORT ON KICKSTARTER: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tidebornehaven/tideborne-haven-a-cozy-farming-sim-about-saving-the-ocean

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4328840/Tideborne_Haven/

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/tideborne_haven?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsh=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/p/Tideborne-Haven-61584475696429/

Discord: 
https://discord.gg/maU7UZGMfT

Tideborne Haven is a cozy, story-driven pixel art life sim set on a fragile tropical island on the brink of collapse.

You arrive by boat to polluted shores, dying reefs, a struggling rainforest, and a community barely holding it together.

As the islands newest caretaker, you’ll restore what’s been lost - cleaning beaches, farming coral, removing invasive species, rebuilding the town, rehabilitating wildlife, and bringing the ecosystem back to life.
